penalty_trigger_decision: Native liquid criterion met at 65 states; owner holds penalty fitting and start1 pending the required decision.

measured_runtime.timing_basis: perf_counter; grid includes worker verification/binding, native optimized and supplied searches and streamed output; total includes parent setup and additional existing Route.pressure_basis calls; excludes agent-heavy admission

classification_basis: Existing Route native density-side classification; supplied trials use existing supplied_negative predicate and density_side, never seed labels. Each retained old negative is instability evidence in the fixed declared model, not physical validation.
limitations: Finite targeted subset; old unavailable searches are retained. Unknown density_side is not inferred; no local numerical thresholds or new Engine evaluation method.
supplied_density_side_limit: All negative supplied evaluations lack density_side on the pinned wheel; zero identified liquid-side states is not evidence of absence. Liquid-side presence is unknown for all 81 requested supplied-negative states.

comparison_inventory.basis: Rerun includes the native endpoint witnesses retained by the first full search; expanded supplied inventory can expose more negative supplied trials.
